notes.title: Students of Light Bonds v1.1 Update Information
notes.notes:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added feature for supporting "Hi-Res Character Creation DLC".
[*]Added version display on bottom-left of Title menu.
[*]Added Windows 11 to supported OS.
[/list]

[h1]About "Hi-Res Character Creation DLC"[/h1]
The DLC named "Hi-Res Character Creation DLC" will be released in the near future.
The main purpose of this update (v1.1) is in order to be able to recognize this DLC from this game application.

After purchased & installed this DLC, at the "Character Creation" menu in this game, you will be able to take each character's photo as a high resolution (2048x4096 pixels) PNG file with transparent background.

For details about this DLC (ex. how to purchase), we will post another information after finished releasing this DLC, which will be tagged (categorized) as "Cross Promotion".

notes.title: Release notification & INTRODUCTORY OFFER! (15% launch discount)
notes.notes:
An indie game developer "Yakuentei" has just released the new work "Students of Light Bonds - Typing RPG with Character Creation -" !

Since the [b]1-week INTRODUCTORY OFFER (15% launch discount) is available[/b], we hope you'll take this opportunity to pick one up if you are interested!


(Following information is almost same as pre-release notification.)

This game supports not only Japanese but also [b]English language[/b].
So, you will be able to enjoy Japanese positive word's romanization (= alphabet) typing even if your language is non-Japanese!

[b]Steam Achievement is also supported.[/b] Total number of available achievements is 30!

notes.title: Notification of scheduled release date & launch discount
notes.notes:
An indie game developer "Yakuentei" has decided to release "Students of Light Bonds - Typing RPG with Character Creation -" on 12/19 7:00 AM PST (= 12/20 12:00 AM JST)!

This game supports not only Japanese but also [b]English[/b] language.
So, you will be able to enjoy Japanese positive word's romanization (= alphabet) typing even if your language is non-Japanese!

[b]Steam Achievement[/b] is also supported. Total number of available achievements will be 30 from immediately after release!

Since the [b]1-week launch discount[/b] is also scheduled, we hope you'll take this opportunity to pick one up if you are interested!
